description: Search for organizations or individuals receiving federal funds by name, UEI (Unique Entity Identifier), or DUNS. Returns recipient hash IDs, UEI/DUNS identifiers, total award amounts, and hierarchy level. Results are paginated — use page to retrieve matches beyond the first page; page_metadata.total reports the full match count. Recipient hash IDs from this tool can be passed to usaspending_get_recipient for full profiles. Recipient level: P = parent organization, C = child entity, R = standalone.

award_type.description: Filter by award type category to scope the total amounts returned

keyword.description: Name, UEI, DUNS, or keyword to search for — partial matches are supported

page.description: Page number (1-based) — request the next page to retrieve matches beyond the first

name: usaspending_search_recipients

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_unavailable`: USAspending.gov API is unreachable or returns an error. `api_timeout`: USAspending.gov did not respond before the request deadline elapsed. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_next.description: Whether there are more pages of results

notice.description: Recovery hint — how to continue to the next page when more results exist, or how to broaden the search when empty. Absent when the full match set fits on this page.

page_metadata.description: Pagination metadata — page through with the page input to reach later matches

has_next.description: Whether there are more pages of results

total.description: Total matching recipients across all pages

recipient_count.description: Number of matching recipients returned on this page

items.description: Recipient entry with ID, name, and award totals

amount.description: Total award amount in USD for the selected award type

id.description: Recipient hash ID (UUID format with level suffix: -P parent, -C child, -R standalone) — pass to usaspending_get_recipient for full profile

recipient_level.description: Hierarchy level: P = parent, C = child, R = standalone

totalCount.description: Total matching recipients across all pages

title: Search Award Recipients
